title: NEFA can serve as good biological markers for the diagnosis of depression in adolescents.
authors: Liu, Guan-Xi; Li, Ze-Lin; Lin, Su-Yan; Luo, Zheng-Yi; Yin, Ya-Nan; Zhou, Yan-Ling; Ning, Yu-Ping
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用GC-MS和机器学习分析青少年抑郁症患者血清非酯化脂肪酸作为诊断标志物，完全不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The incidence of adolescent depression has markedly risen in recent years, with a high recurrence rate into adulthood. Diagnosis in adolescents is challenging due to subjective factors, highlighting the crucial need for objective diagnostic markers. METHODS: Our study enrolled 204 participants, including healthy controls (n = 88) and first-episode adolescent depression patients (n = 116). Serum samples underwent gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) analysis to assess non-esterified fatty acids (NEFA) expression. Machine learning and ROC analysis were employed to identify potential biomarkers, followed by bioinformatics analysis to explore underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: Nearly all differentially expressed NEFA exhibited significant downregulation. Notably, nonanoic acid, cis-10-pentadecenoic acid, cis-10-carboenoic acid, and cis-11-eicosenoic acid demonstrated excellent performance in distinguishing adolescent depression patients. Metabolite-gene interaction analysis revealed these NEFAs interacted with multiple genes. KEGG pathway analysis on these genes suggested that differentially expressed NEFA may impact PPAR and cAMP signaling pathways. LIMITATIONS: Inclusion of diverse populations for evaluation is warranted. Biomarkers identified in this study require samples that are more in line with the experimental design for external validation, and further basic research is necessary to validate the potential depressive mechanisms of NEFA. CONCLUSIONS: The overall reduction in NEFA expression in first-episode adolescent depression patients suggests a potential mediation of depression symptoms through cAMP and PPAR signaling pathways. NEFA levels show promise as a diagnostic tool for identifying first-episode adolescent depression patients.
abstract_zh: 背景：近年来，青少年抑郁症的发病率显著上升，且成年后复发率较高。由于主观因素，青少年抑郁症的诊断面临挑战，这凸显了客观诊断标志物的迫切需求。方法：本研究招募了204名参与者，包括健康对照组（n = 88）和首发青少年抑郁症患者（n = 116）。血清样本采用气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析，以评估非酯化脂肪酸（NEFA）的表达水平。采用机器学习及ROC分析来识别潜在生物标志物，随后进行生物信息学分析以探索潜在机制。结果：几乎所有差异表达的NEFA均表现出显著下调。值得注意的是，壬酸、顺式-10-十五碳烯酸、顺式-10-碳烯酸和顺式-11-二十碳烯酸在区分青少年抑郁症患者方面表现出优异性能。代谢物-基因相互作用分析显示，这些NEFA与多个基因相互作用。对这些基因的KEGG通路分析提示，差异表达的NEFA可能影响PPAR和cAMP信号通路。局限性：需要纳入多样化人群进行评估。本研究中识别的生物标志物需要更符合实验设计的样本进行外部验证，且需进一步的基础研究来验证NEFA潜在的抑郁机制。结论：首发青少年抑郁症患者中NEFA表达的整体降低，提示其可能通过cAMP和PPAR信号通路介导抑郁症状。NEFA水平有望作为识别首发青少年抑郁症患者的诊断工具。
